
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/mchao/p/19727871" title="发布于 2026-03-17 10:10">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">如果没有 Tools，Agent 什么都做不了</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<div class="lake-content">
<p id="b7b40a1e">很多人刚接触 Agent 时，会有一个很自然的想法：</p>
<p id="u003103de" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">只要模型够强，Agent 就能完成各种任务。</span></p>
<p id="ucd5863f7" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">但在实际系统里，很快就会发现一件事：</span></p>
<p id="u31cbb6b9" class="ne-p"><strong>没有 Tools，Agent 什么都做不了。</strong></p>
<p id="u6e07ed4e" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">因为大模型本质上只会做一件事：</span></p>
<p id="u27783e51" class="ne-p"><strong>生成文本。</strong></p>
<hr id="d9SnP" class="ne-hr">
<h2 id="7a35a281"><span class="ne-text">一、LLM 本身不会执行任何操作</span></h2>
<p id="u747b74b3" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">举一个简单例子。</span></p>
<p id="u86950881" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">如果问模型：</span></p>
<p id="u59c31fdd" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">北京现在的天气怎么样？</span></p>
<p id="ub89f9c9a" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">模型会给出类似这样的回答：</span></p>
<p id="u9b4f823b" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">北京今天大概是晴天，气温可能在 20°C 左右。</span></p>
<p id="u5eb3b12e" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">这看起来像是一个查询结果，但实际上：</span></p>
<p id="ufb58fd69" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">模型并没有访问任何真实数据。</span></p>
<p id="ub99343cb" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">它只是根据训练数据和上下文，生成了一个“看起来合理”的答案。</span></p>
<p id="uc8eeb5e9" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">LLM 的工作方式其实很简单：</span></p>
<p id="u9a935f3c" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">根据已有的上下文，预测下一个 token。</span></p>
<p id="u43d1bfa5" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">它不会：</span></p>
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="u8b664446" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">查询数据库</span></li>
<li id="u97d12636" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">调用 API</span></li>
<li id="u70357114" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">访问互联网</span></li>
<li id="ud37f7d68" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">操作系统</span></li>
</ul>
<p id="ue0859267" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">换句话说：</span></p>
<p id="ufd7ff9fe" class="ne-p"><strong>模型本身没有任何执行能力。</strong></p>
<hr id="xjFWr" class="ne-hr">
<h2 id="230e4985"><span class="ne-text">二、Agent 为什么必须有 Tools</span></h2>
<p id="ub8ae44c9" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">如果希望 Agent 真正完成任务，就必须给它提供一种能力：</span></p>
<p id="u656a877e" class="ne-p"><strong>调用外部系统。</strong></p>
<p id="u1f0e5d3c" class="ne-p"><img src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/jpeg/503577/1773658050023-8db00991-2bda-4cbc-8dfc-ded1bec9b3d0.jpeg" width="500" id="GYGR0" class="ne-image" title=""></p>
<p id="u9c7840fb" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">这就是 Tools 的作用。</span></p>
<p id="ue29a3209" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">从工程角度看，Tool 其实就是一个可以被 Agent 调用的函数。</span></p>
<p id="u9cbebb68" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">例如：</span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-python" data-language="python"><code>def get_weather(city: str):
    ...</code></pre>
<p id="u378e060a" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">或者：</span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-python" data-language="python"><code>def query_order(order_id: str):
    ...</code></pre>
<p id="uddf2edef" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">如果是设备控制系统，可能是：</span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-python" data-language="python"><code>def stage_move(x: float, y: float):
    ...</code></pre>
<p id="u522f66e3" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">这些函数才是真正执行任务的地方。</span></p>
<p id="ua5ba3ac0" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">模型只负责一件事：</span></p>
<p id="u7195c824" class="ne-p"><strong>决定什么时候调用哪个 Tool。</strong></p>
<p id="uf0ab0274" class="ne-p"><img src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/jpeg/503577/1773658047746-05673a78-3b72-4f32-a428-a7e67507a245.jpeg" width="500" id="CvgUU" class="ne-image" title=""></p>
<hr id="r41JZ" class="ne-hr">
<h2 id="61a8116c"><span class="ne-text">三、Agent 的执行流程</span></h2>
<p id="u1ce3fecb" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">在一个典型的 Agent 系统里，大致流程是这样的：</span></p>
<p id="u9feefbc8" class="ne-p"><img src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/jpeg/503577/1773658046201-aead09be-bda3-4fe1-a83e-8fe9a802e6da.jpeg" width="500" id="qFKpz" class="ne-image" title=""></p>
<p id="ua71c590a" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">用户提出请求：</span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>北京天气怎么样？</code></pre>
<p id="u268ec00b" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">Agent 分析问题后，决定调用工具：</span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>get_weather("北京")</code></pre>
<p id="u7bcdd1cb" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">系统执行这个函数，并返回结果：</span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>temperature: 18
condition: sunny</code></pre>
<p id="u41d8762d" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">Agent 再根据返回结果生成回答：</span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>北京今天晴，18°C。</code></pre>
<p id="uecda58a9" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">在这个过程中：</span></p>
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="uaee4ff88" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">LLM 负责决策</span></li>
<li id="ud9e4da30" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">Tool 负责执行</span></li>
</ul>
<p id="u854934b5" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">真正获取数据的，是 Tool，而不是模型。</span></p>
<hr id="h77oY" class="ne-hr">
<h2 id="668f6389"><span class="ne-text">四、没有 Tools 的 Agent 会发生什么</span></h2>
<p id="u9482c573" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">如果一个 Agent 没有任何 Tool，它就只能根据上下文生成答案。</span></p>
<p id="ub4b6779b" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">例如：</span></p>
<p id="u5a9a6efa" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">用户问：</span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>帮我查一下订单状态</code></pre>
<p id="u4f146d3a" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">Agent 可能会回答：</span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>订单已经发货，预计两天后送达。</code></pre>
<p id="u8a459b0f" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">但实际上：</span></p>
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="u9e919005" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">它没有访问订单系统</span></li>
<li id="u15e2f816" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">没有查询数据库</span></li>
<li id="u396fcc43" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">没有调用任何 API</span></li>
</ul>
<p id="u125ac83e" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">这个回答只是一个“合理猜测”。</span></p>
<p id="uf02fc3fc" class="ne-p"><img src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/jpeg/503577/1773658047203-ee49bdf3-8533-45c6-bddc-bdc271577acf.jpeg" width="500" id="Ky0Ts" class="ne-image" title=""></p>
<p id="u710db78a" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">这也是很多所谓 AI 应用的问题：</span></p>
<p id="u1f103426" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">看起来很聪明，但实际上并没有真正连接业务系统。</span></p>
<hr id="QYLxY" class="ne-hr">
<h2 id="c53b277b"><span class="ne-text">五、Tools 的作用：连接真实系统</span></h2>
<p id="uc9533d9a" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">在工程实践中，Tools 的作用非常明确：</span></p>
<p id="u46875fa0" class="ne-p"><strong>把模型和真实系统连接起来。</strong></p>
<p id="ub3bb1390" class="ne-p"><img src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/jpeg/503577/1773658050813-6eff39e0-e4e0-4015-b6aa-98a8514fd44b.jpeg" width="500" id="YtA8a" class="ne-image" title=""></p>
<p id="ucbb37088" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">例如：</span></p>
<p id="uec3efa0d" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">信息查询类：</span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>search
weather
database query
vector search</code></pre>
<p id="ub5ef357d" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">系统操作类：</span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>file_read
file_write
shell
git</code></pre>
<p id="u341c83c9" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">业务系统：</span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>create_order
query_user
send_email</code></pre>
<p id="u2e98705e" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">设备控制：</span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>robot_pick
robot_place
stage_move
loadport_dock</code></pre>
<p id="u9d7f9ed6" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">这些工具提供的能力，决定了 Agent 实际能做什么。</span></p>
<hr id="GwzhP" class="ne-hr">
<h2 id="acb39854"><span class="ne-text">六、Agent 的能力取决于 Tools</span></h2>
<p id="ubad4acbe" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">从系统角度看，一个 Agent 能做什么，其实取决于：</span></p>
<p id="u26b01d8d" class="ne-p"><strong>它有哪些 Tools。</strong></p>
<p id="ub2fa7fa0" class="ne-p"><img src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/jpeg/503577/1773658052237-9f890203-6bd4-467c-a20c-7b00b76d596a.jpeg" width="500" id="N4Cqv" class="ne-image" title=""></p>
<p id="ufc4c00bb" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">例如：</span></p>
<p id="u4f4c0367" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">没有 Tool：</span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>聊天机器人</code></pre>
<p id="ud1430791" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">有搜索 Tool：</span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>搜索助手</code></pre>
<p id="u8a34d88b" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">有数据库 Tool：</span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>业务系统助手</code></pre>
<p id="ufe6c8d1c" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">有设备控制 Tool：</span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>自动化控制系统</code></pre>
<p id="uda3e30d4" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">模型本身并不会直接决定系统能力。</span></p>
<p id="u14b01fd5" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">真正决定能力边界的，是 Tool 集合。</span></p>
<hr id="Ff6b3" class="ne-hr">
<h2 id="ee2e921f"><span class="ne-text">七、最小的 Agent 结构</span></h2>
<p id="u6ee6f3ac" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">如果从工程角度抽象，一个最小的 Agent 系统其实只有三部分：</span></p>
<p id="udb7266d3" class="ne-p"><img src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/jpeg/503577/1773658052949-3540200e-4168-4b4e-8cdf-ad546fc0420c.jpeg" width="500" id="hEOZJ" class="ne-image" title=""></p>
<p id="ub4d88cb9" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text"> LLM 负责：</span></p>
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="u995c98e4" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">理解任务</span></li>
<li id="u38dcfb8e" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">决定下一步行动</span></li>
</ul>
<p id="u6b81e3b5" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">Tools 负责：</span></p>
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="ubffc067b" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">执行操作</span></li>
</ul>
<p id="u7e95078c" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">Loop 负责：</span></p>
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="uba28eed1" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">维持整个执行过程</span></li>
</ul>
<p id="u32c2d0e2" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">大致结构可以理解为：</span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-plain" data-language="plain"><code>User
  │
  ▼
Agent
  ├─ LLM（决策）
  ├─ Tools（执行）
  └─ Loop（调度）</code></pre>
<hr id="TWnDD" class="ne-hr">
<h2 id="afab9336"><span class="ne-text">八、小结</span></h2>
<p id="u6eadbec4" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">很多人会把 Agent 理解为：</span></p>
<p id="u5a291835" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">“更聪明的 ChatGPT”。</span></p>
<p id="ub20c3537" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">但从工程实现角度看，更准确的理解是：</span></p>
<p id="u791300c6" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">Agent = 模型 + 工具调用系统</span></p>
<p id="u0fb7eb97" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">模型负责决策。</span></p>
<p id="ubf5d25a0" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">工具负责执行。</span></p>
<p id="u5174846a" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">如果没有 Tools，Agent 就只能停留在文本生成层面，而无法真正完成任务。</span></p>
</div>

</div>

地势坤，君子以厚德载物；
